title: Portugais 33 — Letter of20April1667
contents: Secret negotiations with the Samorim over pepper, with instructions to avoid giving offence to the Dutch.
fields: 33 letter forms; one complete cipher passage.
Plaintext in another folio of the same volume
Separate historical decipherment on f60r/PDF127 and copied text on f119r/PDF245. Names and date variants remain distinct from original f59r.

excerpt: **prudencia. Com tudo me pareceo lembrarvos que com aquelle rei se deve trata[r] com todo o segredo por que os Olandezes se nam dem por ofendidos.**
translation: …prudence. Nevertheless, it seemed right to remind you that dealings with that king must be conducted with complete secrecy so that the Dutch do not take offence.
